title: E-GMT-0036: walking a closed loop in the bulk rotates the parallel-transported frame by exactly the enclosed area...
purpose: Experiment E-GMT-0036 in the geometry arena: walking a closed loop in the bulk rotates the parallel-transported frame by exactly the enclosed area (holonomy from turning equals area from integration to a part in a million, growing without bound with loop size), while a flat loop returns the frame unchanged.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
